classificationPolicy.neverRegisteredCandidatePolicy: not emitted from packet-local evidence alone because replay-wide lifecycle history is not known
classificationPolicy.removedEntityCandidatePolicy: low-confidence candidate only when same entity index has a prior packet-local removal entry before the missing reference
classificationPolicy.registryStateLossCandidatePolicy: low-confidence candidate only when same entity index has prior packet-local create/register evidence but registry state is missing at failure
classificationPolicy.indexStreamSuspectedPolicy: reserved for future evidence; this implementation does not infer it from a large index delta alone
